name: thumbnail

face_region._note: face area in the final 9:16 video (layout of the tiktok-vertical preset)

neutral._note: face.py: score of each frame (0 = neutral). Higher weight = that flaw counts more. fps = frames analysed per second; spacing_s = minimum gap between candidates; margin_s = ignores the start and the end

_note_text: size = font size; thumb.py shrinks it (2 px at a time, down to size_min) until the longest word fits the width and the text fits in max_lines and the free space. If it still does not fit: error (shorten the text).

vertical_9x16._note: important content in the central band (safe = y 240-1680): the profile grid crops the edges. thumb.py checks that everything stays inside it

youtube_16x9._note: face in a square on the right (full height); texts in the left column
